arxiv-2109-14134.description: Abstract The unitary coupled cluster (UCC) approximation is one of the more promising wave-function ansätze for electronic structure calculations on quantum computers via the variational quantum eigensolver algorithm. arxiv-2203-03070.creator: Francesca Angrisani, Franco Rampazzo
arxiv-2203-03070.description: Abstract . Higher order necessary conditions for a minimizer of an optimal control problem are generally obtained for systems whose dynamics is continuously differentiable in the state variable. Here, by making use of the notion of set-valued Lie bracket we obtain a Goh-type condition for a control affine system with Lipschitz continuous dynamics and unbounded controls.
